title: Diffusion-adapted Evo genomic model generates functional promoters in gut commensals
summary: DAPE-PD adapts the autoregressive Evo genomic foundation model into a bidirectional masked diffusion model to generate cis-regulatory DNA without foundation-scale retraining. After genus-specific fine-tuning, generated sequences kept genus-associated compositional features despite low similarity to the fine-tuning data. Experimental validation identified functional de novo promoters, and in silico prioritization recovered active designs from small candidate sets in three non-model gut commensals; the abstract gives no yield rate.
